info.name: Prism Collector-Mediated Production Flow Demo
info.description: Guided live demo for the intended production telemetry path: Postman → OpenTelemetry Collector (:4318) → Prism Ingestion API (:8000) → Prism Dashboard (:8080). Before running: start Prism UI and ingestion services, seed local data with `py -3.14 scripts\\seed_postman_data.py --reset`, set PRISM_OTLP_EXPORT_API_KEY to the seeded project key, then start otelcol-contrib with config/otel-collector-config.yaml. This collection never sends the Prism project key from Postman; the Collector adds it on the Collector-to-Prism hop.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('demo_run_id')) {
pm.environment.set('demo_run_id', `demo-${Date.now()}`);
pm.test('Prism dashboard is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Collector health extension is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('demo operator login succeeds', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(302));
const token = pm.cookies.get('csrf_token');
pm.test('CSRF cookie is supplied', () => pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);
pm.environment.set('csrf_token', token);
pm.test('demo project is selected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 02 - Send language-agnostic OTLP log batch through Collector

exec: pm.test('Collector accepts the OTLP log batch', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Postman did not send a Prism authorization header', () => pm.expect(pm.request.headers.get('Authorization')).to.be.null);

item.name: 03 - Send traces and metrics through Collector

exec: pm.test('Collector accepts OTLP trace input', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Collector accepts OTLP metric input', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Prism returns the selected project incidents', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const responseText = pm.response.text();
pm.test('collector-forwarded MuleSoft incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('Payment gateway connection refused'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Java incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('Read timed out after 3000 ms'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Python incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('warehouse_id field required'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Node.js incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include("Cannot read properties of undefined"));
pm.test('collector-forwarded .NET incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('Object reference not set'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Go incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('nil pointer dereference'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Ruby incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('Attempted to update a stale object'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded PHP incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('Serialization failure'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Rust incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('called Option::unwrap()'));
pm.test('collector-forwarded Kotlin/JVM incident is visible', () => pm.expect(responseText).to.include('No active pricing rules'));

item.name: Open Prism dashboard for visual demo

exec: pm.test('incident dashboard is available to the demo operator', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
